name: Sobhagya Mercantile Limited
about: Sobhagya Mercantile Limited engages in the selling of metal products in India. It operates through Engineering Consultancy and Metal Sale (Stone Crusher) segments. The company constructs roads. It is also involved in the coal mining activity; equipment leasing; and offers steel products. In addition, the company offers engineering design, planning and estimation of a project, market studies, feasibility report preparation, project management services, architectural and construction engineering services, project commissioning, operations and maintenance, and advisory services for road and irrigation projects, as well as engineering consultancy solutions. Sobhagya Mercantile Limited incorporated in 1983 and is based in Nagpur, India.
